headline: AI Data Analyst Job Description: 2026 Template + Skills Matrix
description: Copy-ready AI data analyst job description for 2026: responsibilities, skills matrix, qualifications, and sample JD for HR and hiring managers. See the FAQ.
keywords: ai data analyst job description, ai data analyst, hiring data analyst, data agent

acceptedAnswer.text: Include goal-framing responsibilities, agent supervision and audit validation, metric governance, stakeholder communication, and explicit mention of agentic tooling.

mainEntity.name: How is this different from a traditional data analyst JD?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional JDs emphasize manual SQL and dashboard building. AI data analyst JDs emphasize orchestration, validation, and governance with agents handling execution.

mainEntity.name: What title should I use — AI Data Analyst or Data Analyst?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use AI Data Analyst if the role explicitly involves autonomous agents. Use Data Analyst with an AI tooling paragraph if evolving an existing role without title change.

mainEntity.name: Is a computer science degree required?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Judgment, domain context, SQL review ability, and communication matter more than degree field.

mainEntity.name: Should the JD mention specific tools like InfiniSynapse?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mention your actual stack. Naming specific agentic platforms signals serious intent and filters candidates better than generic AI tools language.

mainEntity.name: Can I use this template for intern or senior levels?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes. Adjust years of experience and autonomy scope. Interns use supervised agents; seniors own governance playbooks and mentor goal engineering.
